description: This file contains the implementation of a concurrent, segmented LRU cache with a TU-Q eviction policy, including internal classes for cache items and telemetry, as well as methods for cache management such as add, remove, update, and trimming. It is designed for high concurrency without global locks, and manages cache segments (hot, warm, cold) with specific cycling logic.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruCache<K, V>
classes.description: A thread-safe, segmented LRU cache implementing a TU-Q eviction policy with hot, warm, and cold segments.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruCache<K, V>.LruItem
classes.description: Represents an individual cache item with key, value, and access metadata, supporting sequence locking for thread safety.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruCache<K, V>.TelemetryPolicy
classes.description: Tracks cache metrics such as hits, misses, evictions, and updates for telemetry purposes.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with the specified key, throwing if not found.

methods.name: TryGet
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the value for a key, returning true if successful.

methods.name: TryAdd
methods.description: Attempts to add a new key-value pair to the cache.

methods.name: GetOrAdd
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a key or adds it using a factory function if not present.

methods.name: TryRemove
methods.description: Attempts to remove a key and its value from the cache.

methods.name: TryUpdate
methods.description: Attempts to update the value for an existing key.

methods.name: AddOrUpdate
methods.description: Adds a new key-value pair or updates the existing one.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all items from the cache.

methods.name: Trim
methods.description: Removes a specified number of least recently used items.
